file.content:
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_source_sha:
        description: 'Merged managed release-PR commit to recover; leave empty for the triggering commit.'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions: {}

# One run at a time: each run asks `callisto release pending` what is unfinished when it starts, so a run queued behind
# a release sees it finished. GitHub keeps one pending run per group, and the surviving run selects the same release.
concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify release candidate
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.release_source_sha == ''
    timeout-minutes: 45
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Build local Callisto
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local

      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@c509219cf42fba86913069efd0ade2458c59337b # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0

      - name: Format Check
        run: just fmt-check

      - name: Clippy Lints
        run: just lint

      - name: Install release verification tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@c509219cf42fba86913069efd0ade2458c59337b # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest,ripgrep

      - name: Install registry test tools
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-registry-test-tools

      - name: Install workflow linters
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-workflow-linters

      - name: Unit & Integration Tests
        run: just test

      - name: Install cargo-deny
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@c509219cf42fba86913069efd0ade2458c59337b # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-deny

      - name: Supply Chain Audit
        run: just audit

      - name: Verify workflow contracts and reject mutable action references
        run: just workflow-contracts

  recovery-checks:
    name: Check release workflow policy for recovery
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.release_source_sha != ''
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install ripgrep
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@c509219cf42fba86913069efd0ade2458c59337b # v2
        with:
          tool: ripgrep
      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@c509219cf42fba86913069efd0ade2458c59337b # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - name: Verify release workflow contracts
        run: just release-workflow-checks

  gate:
    name: The release gate passed
    needs: [verify, recovery-checks]
    # Exactly one gate runs per event; a failed gate matches neither clause, so this job is skipped and everything that
    # needs it is too. Planning and building do not wait for it; publishing and the release PR refresh do.
    if: >-
      always() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      ((needs.verify.result == 'success' && needs.recovery-checks.result == 'skipped') ||
       (needs.recovery-checks.result == 'success' && needs.verify.result == 'skipped'))
    timeout-minutes: 5
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - run: echo 'The verification gate passed.'

  release-candidate:
    name: Identify a merged Callisto release PR
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      is_release_pr: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.is_release_pr }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
      release_pr_number: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_pr_number }}
      orchestration_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - id: candidate
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}
          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_source_sha="$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT"
          selected_pending=false
          if [[ -z "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            release_source_sha=$(callisto --format json release pending | jq -r '.pending[0].source // empty')
            [[ -n "$release_source_sha" ]] && selected_pending=true
            release_source_sha="${release_source_sha:-$TRIGGERING_SHA}"
          fi
          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
            exit 1
          fi
          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')
          if [[ "$resolved_sha" != "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha does not resolve to that exact commit"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$release_source_sha" "$TRIGGERING_SHA"; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha is not on main's history"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Attestations are stamped with this run's own SHA, so the
          # coordinator must be exactly the revision running this workflow.
          orchestration_sha="$TRIGGERING_SHA"
          # Only schedules the job: `release plan` verifies the parent-to-merge delta, and labels are never authority.
          # The API check adds provenance: a trusted merge is a real merge of the managed PR with a GitHub-verified signature.
          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" | jq -s --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg sha "$release_source_sha" '[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .merge_commit_sha == $sha and .base.ref == "main" and .head.repo.full_name == $repo and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$")))) | .number]')
          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
          if [[ "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then
            {
              echo 'is_release_pr=true'
              echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"
              echo "release_pr_number=$(jq -r '.[0]' <<< "$prs")"
              echo "orchestration_sha=$orchestration_sha"
            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [[ "$selected_pending" == true || -n "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT" || "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" != 0 ]]; then
            echo "::error::release source is not one verified merged managed PR"
            exit 1
          else
            echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  version-pr:
    name: Create or update the Callisto release PR
    needs: [release-candidate, gate, drain]
    if: >-
      always() && needs.gate.result == 'success' && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
      ((needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr != 'true' &&
        needs.drain.result == 'skipped' && inputs.release_source_sha == '') ||
       (needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true' &&
        needs.drain.result == 'success' && needs.drain.outputs.has_pending == 'false'))
    timeout-minutes: 10
    concurrency:
      group: version-pr
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    outputs:
      has_pending_changesets: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Compose, version, and open the release PR
        id: version-pr
        uses: $/.github/actions/callisto-action
        with:
          setup_callisto: 'false'
          branch: main
          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
  plan:
    name: Derive ephemeral intent from the merged release commit
    needs: release-candidate
    if: needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_artifacts: ${{ steps.slots.outputs.has_artifacts }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # The coordinator must be the current workflow revision. Recovery
          # never rebuilds its release engine from historic source.
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Derive and hash intent
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          mkdir -p "$handoff_dir"
          callisto release plan --source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" \
            --decision "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source/.callisto/release-decision.json" \
            --out "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
          # Relative name: the consumers verify from a different runner OS and RUNNER_TEMP.
          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)
      - name: Read declared artifact slot count
        id: slots
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Own statement: set -e cannot see a substitution failing inside an echo argument.
          has_artifacts=$(jq '.artifactSlots | length > 0' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json")
          case "$has_artifacts" in
            true|false) ;;
            *) echo "::error::artifact slot probe returned '$has_artifacts'"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "has_artifacts=$has_artifacts" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error
          # A stuck run may need "execute" re-run days later; a short retention would force a full rerun.
          retention-days: 7

  build-artifact:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.target }} from the intent-bound source tree
    needs: [plan, release-candidate]
    if: always() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - id: macos-arm64
            runner: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: macos-x64
            runner: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
            kind: cross
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      attestations: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - name: Verify handoff
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          callisto release inspect --input "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts"
      - name: Build declared artifact
        env:
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET: ${{ matrix.asset }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/release-source
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
        run: |
          bash .github/scripts/build-release-artifact.sh
      - name: Attest exact artifact bytes
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build-${{ matrix.id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          # A stuck run may need "execute" re-run days later; a short retention would force a full rerun.
          retention-days: 7

  build:
    name: Assemble attested product artifacts
    needs: [build-artifact, release-candidate, plan]
    if: always() && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true' && needs.build-artifact.result == 'success'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    outputs:
      orchestration_sha: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      # Every matrix target's artifact, so a target added to the matrix cannot be built and then left out of the manifest.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: release-build-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
      - name: Create exact artifact manifest
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          callisto release artifact-manifest --intent "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json" --artifact-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts" --out "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts/manifest.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  execute:
    name: Execute approved release
    needs: [plan, build, release-candidate, gate]
    # Artifact-less sources skip build; a failed or cancelled build must still block.
    # !cancelled() not always(): a status function still defeats the skipped-ancestor
    # rule, but cancelling the run must stop the one irreversible job.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.gate.result == 'success' && needs.plan.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'false' || needs.build.result == 'success')
    timeout-minutes: 60
    concurrency:
      group: release-execute
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      attestations: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          # The release-source checkout alone needs Git credentials because
          # graph-owned tag dispatch pushes from this repository.
          persist-credentials: true
      # Downloaded under $RUNNER_TEMP: `release execute` needs a clean worktree, so landing these in the checkout would fail it.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build
      - name: Verify same-run handoff before credentials
        env:
          HAS_ARTIFACTS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          (cd "$intent_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          if [[ "$HAS_ARTIFACTS" == true ]]; then
            cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          fi
      - name: Execute verified release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          receipt_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          mkdir -p "$receipt_dir"
          args=(--source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" --intent "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" --receipt "$receipt_dir/release-receipt.json" --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA")
          if [[ -f "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$build_dir/release-artifacts")
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
      # Needs no secrets: a plain tag push with the checkout's Git credentials, like the release tags. A no-op before 1.0.0.
      - name: Move the floating major tag
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/scripts/move-floating-tag.sh" .callisto/release-decision.json cargo/callisto-cli "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Summarize receipt
        if: always()
        run: |
          receipt="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/release-receipt.json"
          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
            {
              echo '### Release receipt'
              echo '```json'
              cat "$receipt"
              echo '```'
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Upload receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          # Per attempt: keeps each attempt's receipt instead of shadowing the prior one.
          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/callisto-release-receipt/${{ github.run_id }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  drain:
    name: Start the next unfinished release
    needs: [execute, release-candidate]
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.execute.result == 'success' &&
      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_pending: ${{ steps.pending.outputs.has_pending }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Dispatch the oldest unfinished release
        id: pending
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The release just executed is excluded: a release that cannot be read back as finished must not start itself again.
          next_sha=$(callisto --format json release pending | jq -r --arg sha "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" '[.pending[] | select(.source != $sha)][0].source // empty')
          if [[ -n "$next_sha" ]]; then
            gh workflow run callisto-release.yml --ref main -f release_source_sha="$next_sha"
            echo 'has_pending=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo 'has_pending=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

1	name: Release

5	# Callisto version PR or, for a merged version PR, runs plan -> build ->
6	# execute. Keep this filename: Callisto's recovery docs and coordinator
7	# identity name `.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml`.

13	    inputs:
14	      release_source_sha:
15	        description: 'Merged Callisto version-PR commit to recover; leave empty for the triggering commit.'
16	        required: false
17	        type: string
18	
19	permissions: {}
20	
21	# One group per commit: GitHub replaces a pending run in a shared group, which
22	# could silently drop a release merge queued behind an unrelated push.
23	concurrency:

33	    name: Identify a merged Callisto version PR
34	    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
35	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
36	    permissions:
37	      contents: read
38	      pull-requests: read
39	    outputs:
40	      is_release: ${{ steps.decision.outputs.is_release }}
41	      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.release_source_sha }}
42	      orchestration_sha: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
43	    steps:
44	      # Scheduling only: `callisto release plan` verifies the actual
45	      # parent-to-merge delta. A release must also be a GitHub-verified merge
46	      # of the managed PR, never a direct push.
47	      - name: Check release-source provenance
48	        id: provenance
49	        env:
50	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
51	          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}
52	          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
53	        run: |
54	          set -euo pipefail
55	          release_source_sha="${RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT:-$TRIGGERING_SHA}"
56	          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
57	            echo "::error::release_source_sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
58	            exit 1
59	          fi
60	          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')
61	          if [[ "$resolved_sha" != "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
62	            echo "::error::release_source_sha does not resolve to that exact commit"
63	            exit 1
64	          fi
65	          # gh rejects --slurp together with --jq, so slurp the pages and filter with jq.
66	          prs=$(gh api --paginate --slurp "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" |
67	            jq --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" '[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .base.ref == "main" and
68	              .head.repo.full_name == $repo and

72	            --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
73	          managed=false
74	          if [[ "$prs" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then managed=true; fi
75	          {
76	            echo "managed=$managed"
77	            echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"
78	            # The current run coordinates; a recovery never reruns historic workflow code.
79	            echo "orchestration_sha=$TRIGGERING_SHA"

432	  # prebuilt binaries for, and uses them (scripts/smoke-published.sh). Needs no secrets and no write access. It

439	      fail-fast: false
440	      matrix:
441	        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-latest]

443	    timeout-minutes: 30
444	    permissions:
445	      contents: read
446	    env:
447	      RELEASED_VERSION: ${{ needs.execute.outputs.smoke_version }}
448	      # Every npm package of this release must carry provenance; a missing one fails the job.
449	      SMOKE_REQUIRE_ATTESTATIONS: '1'
450	    steps:
451	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
452	        with:
453	          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
454	          persist-credentials: false
455	
456	      - name: Install the published packages and use them
457	        run: scripts/smoke-published.sh "$RELEASED_VERSION"

file.content:
name: Release

# Callisto's build-matrix release flow for napi platform packages
# (docs/releasing.md in orin-dx/callisto): a push to main either refreshes the
# Callisto version PR or, for a merged version PR, runs plan -> build ->
# execute. Keep this filename: Callisto's recovery docs and coordinator
# identity name `.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml`.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_source_sha:
        description: 'Merged Callisto version-PR commit to recover; leave empty for the triggering commit.'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions: {}

# One group per commit: GitHub replaces a pending run in a shared group, which
# could silently drop a release merge queued behind an unrelated push.
concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  release-candidate:
    name: Identify a merged Callisto version PR
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      is_release: ${{ steps.decision.outputs.is_release }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.release_source_sha }}
      orchestration_sha: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
    steps:
      # Scheduling only: `callisto release plan` verifies the actual
      # parent-to-merge delta. A release must also be a GitHub-verified merge
      # of the managed PR, never a direct push.
      - name: Check release-source provenance
        id: provenance
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}
          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_source_sha="${RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT:-$TRIGGERING_SHA}"
          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
            exit 1
          fi
          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')
          if [[ "$resolved_sha" != "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha does not resolve to that exact commit"
            exit 1
          fi
          # gh rejects --slurp together with --jq, so slurp the pages and filter with jq.
          prs=$(gh api --paginate --slurp "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" |
            jq --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" '[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .base.ref == "main" and
              .head.repo.full_name == $repo and
              (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or
               (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$"))))] | length')
          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" \
            --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
          managed=false
          if [[ "$prs" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then managed=true; fi
          {
            echo "managed=$managed"
            echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"
            # The current run coordinates; a recovery never reruns historic workflow code.
            echo "orchestration_sha=$TRIGGERING_SHA"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: steps.provenance.outputs.managed == 'true'
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false

      # `release plan --from-release-commit` requires the commit to write its
      # release decision. A managed PR without one (e.g. a workflow fix merged
      # from a callisto/ branch) refreshes the version PR instead.
      - name: Check for a release decision
        id: decision
        env:
          MANAGED: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.managed }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          is_release=false
          if [[ "$MANAGED" == true ]] && git rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD^ > /dev/null &&
            git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only --diff-filter=AM -r HEAD^ HEAD | grep -qxF .callisto/release-decision.json; then
            is_release=true
          fi
          echo "is_release=$is_release" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  version-pr:
    name: Create or update the Callisto version PR
    needs: release-candidate
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: callisto-version-pr
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      # The default version command (`callisto version`) refreshes lockfiles
      # and the action appends --emit-decision .callisto/release-decision.json.
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-action@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
        with:
          mode: version-pr
          version: callisto@0.17.0
          branch: main
          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  plan:
    name: Plan the release from the merged version PR
    needs: release-candidate
    if: needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.matrix }}
      napi_dir: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.napi_dir }}
      has_napi: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_napi }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.17.0

      - name: Plan the release
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent"
          callisto release plan --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" --decision .callisto/release-decision.json \
            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)

      - name: Build the matrix from the intent's napi targets
        id: matrix
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          # This workflow builds napi addons only. Artifact slots or PyPI
          # publishes need the generated workflow's artifact-manifest path.
          if ! jq -e '(.artifactSlots // []) == [] and
            ([.operations[].id.package | select(startswith("pypi/"))] == [])' "$intent" > /dev/null; then
            echo "::error::the release intent declares artifact slots or PyPI publishes, which this workflow does not build"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Only packages in the release intent: an unrelated addon adds no build.
          {
            while IFS= read -r package; do
              callisto --format json matrix --package "$package"
            done < <(jq -r '[.operations[].id.package] | unique[]' "$intent")
          } | jq -s '{platformTargets: (map(.platformTargets) | add // {})}' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/matrix.json"
          # Callisto 0.11 schedules x86_64-apple-darwin on macos-13, a retired
          # runner image: build it on the arm64 macos-latest instead, where
          # rustup's x86_64-apple-darwin target links with Apple's universal SDK.
          # Every other target keeps Callisto's hostRunner/useCross (aarch64
          # Linux cross-compiles with cargo-zigbuild on ubuntu-latest).
          matrix=$(jq -c '[.platformTargets[] | select(.kind == "napi") | .targets[]] | unique_by(.artifactName) |
            map(if .triple == "x86_64-apple-darwin" then .hostRunner = "macos-latest" | .useCross = false else . end)' \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/matrix.json")
          # Execute places one package's JS binding; a second addon needs per-package placement. A release with no
          # addon skips the build and placement entirely (the fixed group always includes the npm package today).
          napi_dirs=$(jq -c '[.[].packageDir] | unique' <<< "$matrix")
          case $(jq length <<< "$napi_dirs") in
            0) has_napi=false napi_dir="" ;;
            1) has_napi=true napi_dir=$(jq -r '.[0]' <<< "$napi_dirs") ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::expected at most one napi package directory, got $napi_dirs"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          {
            echo "matrix=$matrix"
            echo "napi_dir=$napi_dir"
            echo "has_napi=$has_napi"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  build:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.triple }}
    needs: [release-candidate, plan]
    # An empty matrix is an error in GitHub Actions, so a release without an addon skips the job instead.
    if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.hostRunner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      TRIPLE: ${{ matrix.triple }}
      USE_CROSS: ${{ matrix.useCross }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install the Rust target
        run: rustup target add "$TRIPLE"

      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          working-directory: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
          cache: 'false'

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # napi's --cross-compile links non-native Linux targets with cargo-zigbuild.
      - name: Install zig
        if: matrix.useCross
        run: pip install ziglang

      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        if: matrix.useCross
        with:
          tool: cargo-zigbuild

      # --output-dir keeps the checkout clean; napi writes the .node file and
      # the generated index.js/index.d.ts there.
      - name: Build the napi addon
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--release --target "$TRIPLE" --output-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-out")
          if [[ "$USE_CROSS" == true ]]; then args+=(--cross-compile); fi
          pnpm build "${args[@]}"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: napi-${{ matrix.artifactName }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/*.node
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      # index.js and index.d.ts are gitignored build outputs the npm package ships.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: binding-${{ matrix.artifactName }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/index.js
            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/index.d.ts
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  execute:
    name: Execute the planned release
    needs: [release-candidate, plan, build]
    # !cancelled() rather than always(): cancelling the run must stop the one irreversible job.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.build.result == 'success' || (needs.build.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'false'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: callisto-release-execute
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    outputs:
      smoke_version: ${{ steps.published.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          # Callisto pushes the release tags from this checkout.
          persist-credentials: true # zizmor: ignore[artipacked]

      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.17.0

      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        with:
          working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir }}
          cache: 'false'

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir }}

      # Downloads land under $RUNNER_TEMP: `release execute` requires a clean worktree.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        with:
          pattern: napi-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-artifacts

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        with:
          pattern: binding-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-bindings

      - name: Verify the handoff
        run: (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)

      # Everything placed here is gitignored, so the checkout stays clean:
      # the .node files go into the committed npm/<platform> package dirs.
      - name: Place the napi artifacts
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bindings=("$RUNNER_TEMP"/napi-bindings/*)
          for binding in "${bindings[@]}"; do
            cmp "${bindings[0]}/index.js" "$binding/index.js"
            cmp "${bindings[0]}/index.d.ts" "$binding/index.d.ts"
          done
          cp "${bindings[0]}/index.js" "${bindings[0]}/index.d.ts" .
          # napi 3.7 joins --output-dir onto the package directory, so pass it relative.
          pnpm exec napi artifacts --output-dir "$(realpath --relative-to="$PWD" "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-artifacts")"
          for manifest in npm/*/package.json; do
            binary="$(dirname "$manifest")/$(jq -r .main "$manifest")"
            if [[ ! -f "$binary" ]]; then
              echo "::error::missing napi artifact $binary"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          if [[ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]]; then
            git status --porcelain
            echo "::error::artifact placement dirtied the release checkout"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Execute the release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: 'true'
          # pnpm 11 publishes the main package natively and ignores NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE (npm, which publishes the six
          # platform packages, honours it). Without this, @orin-dx/michi shipped with no attestation through 0.7.1.
          PNPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: 'true'
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Callisto hands this config only to its npm publishers; the token
          # stays an ${NPM_TOKEN} reference, never written to disk.
          # shellcheck disable=SC2016
          printf '//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NPM_TOKEN}\n' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          chmod 600 "$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          export CALLISTO_PUBLISH_NPM_CONFIG="$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt"
          callisto release execute --intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" \
            --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json" \
            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA"

      # Callisto writes the receipt only after every selected operation succeeded. A registry publish that landed in
      # this run (`published`) or that a re-run adopted from a failed earlier attempt (`alreadySatisfied`) names the
      # released version here. A receipt without registry publishes, or no receipt, leaves the output empty and
      # skips the post-release smoke test.
      - name: Find the version this run released
        id: published
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(scripts/released-version.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json")
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Summarize the receipt
        if: always()
        run: |
          receipt="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json"
          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
            {
              echo '### Release receipt'
              echo '```json'
              cat "$receipt"
              echo '```'
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          # Per attempt: a re-run keeps each attempt's receipt instead of shadowing it.
          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-receipt
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30

  # Installs the versions just published from the public registries into clean projects on each platform we ship
  # prebuilt binaries for, and uses them (scripts/smoke-published.sh). Needs no secrets and no write access. It
  # cannot undo a release: a failure here is the alarm that the published packages are broken.
  smoke-published:
    name: Smoke-test the published release (${{ matrix.os }})
    needs: [release-candidate, execute]
    if: needs.execute.result == 'success' && needs.execute.outputs.smoke_version != ''
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      RELEASED_VERSION: ${{ needs.execute.outputs.smoke_version }}
      # Every npm package of this release must carry provenance; a missing one fails the job.
      SMOKE_REQUIRE_ATTESTATIONS: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install the published packages and use them
        run: scripts/smoke-published.sh "$RELEASED_VERSION"

9 AST-aware code search for TypeScript and JavaScript.
10 Built for AI coding agents, not humans reading a terminal. 11

12 13 > **Status: early.** `monokl search` works today for TypeScript and JavaScript. Symbol lookup, references, definitions and dependents are designed (see [`docs/spec/`](docs/spec/README.md)) but not built yet. 14 15 --- 16 17 ## What you get 18 19 Grep finds text. Embeddings find _vibes_. monokl parses your code with a compiler-grade parser ([OXC](https://oxc.rs)), so a search returns the **function, class, interface or type** that matches, not a line number to open and read. 20 21 - **Whole code units, best first.** Results are ranked, with functions, classes and methods ahead of imports and re-exports. A search for `format price` puts `formatCurrency` and `validatePrice` first, because names are split on `camelCase`, `snake_case` and acronyms before matching. 22 - **A small query language.** Plain words, `"quoted phrases"`, `+required` and `-excluded` terms, and `regex:` patterns. See [Writing a query](#writing-a-query). 23 - **Your project's rules apply.** Files that `.gitignore` or `.ignore` exclude, hidden files, test files and binary files are skipped by default, and each has a flag to include it. 24 - **Output sized for an agent's context.** Results are a compact table with paths relative to where you ran it, capped at 50 results, 20,000 tokens and 2 MiB by default. When something is cut, the output says how many more matched and suggests narrowing the query. 25 - **Predictable.** The same search on the same files gives the same output, in the same order, every time. A bad pattern fails the whole search with a clear error instead of being quietly dropped.

# Pin the id: moon otherwise derives it from the directory name, which differs in a worktree checkout. The root is a

id: "michi-workspace"
language: rust

  build:
    script: "cargo build --workspace"
    inputs:
      - "crates/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"

    script: "cargo nextest run --workspace --all-features"
    inputs:
      - "crates/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"
    deps:
      - build

  lint:
    script: "cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings"
    inputs:
      - "crates/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"

  format:
    script: "cargo fmt --all"
    inputs:
      - "crates/**/*"

  format-check:
    script: "cargo fmt --all --check"
    inputs:
      - "crates/**/*"

  audit:
    script: "cargo deny check advisories"
    inputs:

  examples:
    script: "cargo run -p michi-core --example basic_toon && cargo run -p michi-core --example agent_response && cargo run -p michi-core --example domain_errors"
    inputs:

# michi — Agent Instructions

## Commands

- Always prefix shell commands with `rtk`.
- `just test` — run all tests (Rust + Node)
- `just test-rust` — Rust tests only (cargo nextest)
- `just check` — fmt + clippy (`--all-targets`, single workspace-wide invocation, matches CI) + rustdoc with warnings denied + fuzz targets build + deny + typos + markdown fmt
- `just pre-push` — fmt-check + `lint-affected` (moon-detected affected crates only, one multi `-p` clippy invocation — not the full workspace)
- `just build-node` — compile NAPI binary for local platform
- `just bench` — run divan benchmarks
- `just snapshots` — review insta snapshot diffs
- `just coverage` — generate lcov.info

## Non-negotiables

- No `unwrap()`/`expect()` in lib code (tests OK with message)
- No `unsafe` outside napi boundary
- `BTreeMap` for output maps, `HashMap` for internal state only
- Pre-allocate strings with `String::with_capacity`
- Truncation uses char boundaries (`floor_char_boundary`)
- Every `pub` item has a doc comment
- NAPI: `version = "3"`, `#[napi(catch_unwind)]` on every export
- Benchmarks: divan (not criterion)
- Tests: `cargo nextest run` (not `cargo test`)

## Testing

- A claim needs a test that fails when the claim breaks. Check by breaking the code on purpose (a mutant) and watching the test fail, then revert.
- Performance: no CI gate on absolute time or percent change (shared runners are too noisy to mean anything). `crates/*/tests/scaling.rs` check the complexity class instead: 10x the input must not take 30x as long (linear ~10x, quadratic ~100x). Add a case there when you add or document a linear-time path. `just bench` is for looking at constant factors by hand.

1	# Architecture decision records
2	
3	Short, dated records of architectural decisions: ones that shape system structure, boundaries, or contracts other code depends on. Not a changelog, not a design doc. Comments, `ARCHITECTURE.md` and `docs/architecture/` explain what the code does.
4	
5	The spec's own decision log, [`docs/spec/05-research-and-decisions.md`](../spec/05-research-and-decisions.md), records how the spec was reached. ADRs record decisions made since, including any that depart from the spec.
6	
7	## Index
8	
9	One line per ADR, with what it guards. Add a line when you add an ADR.
10	
11	- [1. Keep FileIoError in monokl instead of a shared io-errors crate](0001-file-io-error-lives-in-monokl.md): do not reintroduce a private registry; move `FileIoError` to a shared crate only when a second tool needs it.
12	- [2. Define Digest in monokl until wisp-contracts exists](0002-digest-lives-in-monokl-until-wisp-contracts.md): do not change `Digest`'s text or serde form; when `wisp-contracts` ships it, re-export and delete monokl's copy.
13	- [3. One crate with core and agent modules, not two crates](0003-single-crate-with-core-and-agent-modules.md): `core` never imports `agent`, never serializes result types, never depends on tiktoken or michi; split into crates only for a reason a feature flag can't meet.
14	
15	Changing any of these needs a new ADR.
16	
17	## When to write one
18	
19	Two gates, both required:
20	
21	1. **Architectural.** It affects system structure (module or crate boundaries, how components interact), a dependency or technology choice that ripples across the codebase, a data format or contract other code depends on, or a cross-cutting constraint (performance model, correctness discipline, security model).
22	2. **Expensive to reverse and not obvious from the code.** If it gets reverted in a year, what breaks, and would anyone know why?
23	
24	If either answer is no, it's not an ADR. A single function's algorithm is a code comment; a bug fix or refactor is a commit message; a naming or style convention belongs in `AGENTS.md` or a lint.
25	
26	## Format
27	
28	One file per decision: `docs/adr/NNNN-short-title.md`, numbered sequentially, never reused. Copy `0000-template.md` to start.
29	
30	- **Never edit history.** If a decision changes, write a new ADR and mark the old one's status `Superseded by NNNN`.

# Architecture decision records

Short, dated records of architectural decisions: ones that shape system structure, boundaries, or contracts other code depends on. Not a changelog, not a design doc. Comments, `ARCHITECTURE.md` and `docs/architecture/` explain what the code does.

The spec's own decision log, [`docs/spec/05-research-and-decisions.md`](../spec/05-research-and-decisions.md), records how the spec was reached. ADRs record decisions made since, including any that depart from the spec.

## Index

One line per ADR, with what it guards. Add a line when you add an ADR.

- [1. Keep FileIoError in monokl instead of a shared io-errors crate](0001-file-io-error-lives-in-monokl.md): do not reintroduce a private registry; move `FileIoError` to a shared crate only when a second tool needs it.
- [2. Define Digest in monokl until wisp-contracts exists](0002-digest-lives-in-monokl-until-wisp-contracts.md): do not change `Digest`'s text or serde form; when `wisp-contracts` ships it, re-export and delete monokl's copy.
- [3. One crate with core and agent modules, not two crates](0003-single-crate-with-core-and-agent-modules.md): `core` never imports `agent`, never serializes result types, never depends on tiktoken or michi; split into crates only for a reason a feature flag can't meet.

Changing any of these needs a new ADR.

## When to write one

Two gates, both required:

1. **Architectural.** It affects system structure (module or crate boundaries, how components interact), a dependency or technology choice that ripples across the codebase, a data format or contract other code depends on, or a cross-cutting constraint (performance model, correctness discipline, security model).
2. **Expensive to reverse and not obvious from the code.** If it gets reverted in a year, what breaks, and would anyone know why?

If either answer is no, it's not an ADR. A single function's algorithm is a code comment; a bug fix or refactor is a commit message; a naming or style convention belongs in `AGENTS.md` or a lint.

## Format

One file per decision: `docs/adr/NNNN-short-title.md`, numbered sequentially, never reused. Copy `0000-template.md` to start.

- **Never edit history.** If a decision changes, write a new ADR and mark the old one's status `Superseded by NNNN`.
